changelog:
## What's New in v1.6.5 — OLED Dark Mode (Optimized Mint #26D07F)

### 🌙 OLED Dark Mode Implementation
- **Optimized Bright Mint (`#26D07F`):** Bright mint action color tuned for high-contrast OLED dark themes.
- **Deep Charcoal Black (`#121214`):** Pure dark background for battery efficiency & reduced eye strain.
- **Elevated Card Container (`#1E1E22`):** Distinct surface layer for card components.
- **Dark Charcoal Button Text (`#121214`):** High contrast dark text inside mint green action buttons (`onPrimary = DarkOnPrimary`).
- **Subtle Divider Lines (`#2D2E32`):** Ultra-thin borders and item dividers.
- **Dark Mode Toggle:** Integrated under *Style & Customization* -> *Theme & Palette Customization*.
